title: Czardas
identity: Monti’s Czárdás has several distinct saxophone arrangements. The inspected Tierolff edition 3515SA is an E-flat alto-saxophone solo with piano or symphonic band, arranged by Alain Crépin; its sample is not interchangeable with the Lemoine/Muto, Carl Fischer/Roberts, Darok/Kovács, or Uetz/Terrett entries in the catalog.

evidence.claim: Lemoine 25210 is an E-flat saxophone/piano transcription by Ken-Ichiro Muto, 8-page score plus 3-page part; retailer labels elementary.
Carl Fischer W1711 is arranged by Charles J. Roberts, alto saxophone/piano, originally Monti's violin/piano work.
Darok edition is titled for alto saxophone and piano and edited by Béla Kovács.
Tierolff lists a distinct alto/piano edition arranged by Alain Crépin and provides sample score images.
Tierolff identifies its 3515SA edition as E-flat alto saxophone with symphonic band or piano, arranged by Alain Crépin; the publisher page provides a two-page score sample.

The inspected two-page sample is titled for E-flat alto saxophone and symphonic band or piano; the opening is marked Largo in 2/4, with the saxophone initially resting while piano chords sound, followed by sustained/slurred tones. The second page shows rapid scalar figuration and sextuplets in the saxophone part, with repeated tempo changes and rallentandos.

score_observations.claim: In the inspected Tierolff/Crépin sample, the saxophone rests through the opening Largo chords before entering softly with a short slurred figure. Page 2 has rapid ascending and descending scalar runs, sextuplets, and high ledger-line notes; the piano part is chordal with frequent rests.

review_focus: Inference from this specific preview: review the transitions from the slow opening to quick scalar and sextuplet passages, plus coordination around repeated tempo changes and rallentandos.
collection_flag: Arrangement of Monti's violin/piano work; multiple saxophone arrangements with distinct editors and editions.

score_links.description: Tierolff/Alain Crépin two-page sample for the E-flat alto saxophone edition with piano or symphonic band.

gaps: Only the Tierolff/Crépin sample was inspected; no score pages were viewed for the Lemoine/Muto, Carl Fischer/Roberts, Darok/Kovács, or Uetz/Terrett variants.
No performance recording was verified or auditioned.
